name: cloud-canvas
description: Cloud Canvas (#1780): Draw, a paint app on the shared Compose canvas (brush, pencil, marker, eraser, fill, shapes, line, text, eyedropper, layers, undo/redo, pinch zoom, PNG export through the Storage Access Framework), with a sibling page Board, an infinite whiteboard (Quickdraw, MIT, vendored offline in a WebView, boards saved to app storage, #1787; the fleet's tldraw build is kept pinned but not shipped: tldraw 5 does not render without a licence key), and Play, a music mixer whose instruments play through a SoundFont engine by default (#1809: FluidSynth 2.5.1, LGPL-2.1, playing the General MIDI bank GeneralUser GS v2.0.3 on a low-latency Oboe stream; every instrument mapped to a GM preset and the kit to the GM drum map) or, as the selectable Classic engine, a sampled grand piano (Salamander Grand Piano, CC-BY 3.0), a sampled acoustic drum kit (MuldjordKit, CC-BY 4.0) and a synth (low-latency AudioTrack, polyphony, velocity layers; the synthesized piano and kit stay as the fallback), a 4 to 8 track mixer with loop recording and WAV export. Draw Enhancer sends a picture and a preset prompt to an image model through OpenRouter (key from Configs > AI or the fleet Account); Music Enhancer is a coming-soon placeholder. #1808 Painter: the Interactive Hexagon Grid, a cell painter on hex, square, triangle and octagon grids in 2D or on a 3D sphere (Three.js r128 and Inter vendored offline in a WebView, state saved to app storage). Bottom nav Draw | Painter | Board | Play | Enhancers: Board also has its own entry (the Draw > Board page stays), and Enhancers holds Draw Enhancer and Music Enhancer on one shared second row.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.
auto_update._doc_enabled: Off because this app compiles no libs:updater: the Store updates it, as it does Cloud Calc and Cloud Search.

The Painter page's own JS (grid generators, paint, erase, clear, strokes, persistence codec) is test/painter/grid.test.js, run with node by the shell tester test-painter.sh.

about.description: Cloud Canvas has five sections, picked in the bottom nav. Draw holds two pages: Draw, a paint app with a brush, pencil, marker, eraser, fill, line, rectangle, ellipse, text and an eyedropper, a colour picker with recent colours, layers, undo and redo, pinch zoom and pan, canvas size presets and PNG export to a folder you choose; and Board, an infinite whiteboard (Quickdraw) that works offline and keeps every board on the phone. Painter colours the cells of a hex, square, triangle or octagon grid, flat or wrapped on a sphere, and keeps each grid's painting on the phone. Play is a music mixer with a sampled grand piano, a sampled acoustic drum kit and a synth, a multitrack mixer with loop recording and WAV export. The piano and drum sounds are real recordings bundled in the app; the synth is computed on the phone.
features: Draw: brush, pencil, marker, eraser, fill, line, rectangle, ellipse, text, eyedropper
Layers with visibility, opacity and order; undo and redo; pinch zoom and pan
Canvas size presets; open a picture to paint over; export PNG to a folder you choose; share
Board: an infinite whiteboard (Quickdraw) with pen and highlighter ink, shapes, arrows, text, sticky notes, images and an eraser; several named boards saved on the phone; works with no network
Play: a sampled grand piano (3 velocity layers, a sample every 3 semitones), a sampled acoustic drum kit (10 pads) and a synth, on a low-latency audio path with polyphony and touch velocity
Mixer with 4 to 8 tracks: volume, pan, mute, solo, loop recording; tempo and metronome; WAV export

Painter: paint or rub out the cells of a hex, square, triangle, octagon, rhombille, trihexagonal, snub square, cairo or elongated triangular grid with six colours; Hide frames (Off, Only between, Only outside, All); grid scale; 2D or 3D Sphere view with pan, zoom and orbit; Active Cells count and Clear; each grid keeps its own painting on the phone; works with no network

screens.name: Draw
screens.what: The canvas with tools, colour, size, opacity and layers.

screens.name: Board
screens.what: The infinite whiteboard with the board picker (new, rename, delete).

screens.name: Painter
screens.what: The cell grid with the shape toggle, Active Cells and Clear on top, and grid scale, Paint | Rubber | View, 2D | 3D Sphere, Center and the colours below.

screens.name: Mixer
screens.what: Tracks with volume, pan, mute, solo and loops.

guide: Pick a tool and draw; two fingers zoom and pan.
Export PNG asks for a folder once.
In Play, press Record and play: one loop pass is recorded on the selected track.
In Draw, the second row switches between Draw and Board; a board saves itself as you draw.
On the piano and the pads, a hit near the bottom edge is louder than one near the top.
In Painter, drag across the grid to paint; Rubber clears cells; View lets you pan (2D) or orbit (3D Sphere), and Center brings the grid back.
about.privacy: No ads, no trackers and no microphone: loops are recorded as notes. Board and Painter are served from the app itself and need no network; boards and the Painter grids are stored only in the app's private storage. Files are written only to the folder you pick. The only network call is the Draw Enhancer's, when you run it. A crash report is saved on the phone and sent only to the phone's own C3 WebServer over loopback.

perms._doc: #1360 every grant this app needs, by libs:perms catalogue id (needs), and the fleet apps that do work for it with the grants THEY must hold (helpers). The ONE declaration: generated into assets/app-perms.json (cloud-android-perms-guard.py --write), drawn by Configs > General > Perms (libs:perms AppPermsSection) with live state, Grant / Open and Grant all, asked at first run (first_run), and reported as 'Missing permission X - Grant' when an operation fails (PermsGate). perms-guard fails when code uses a gated API or another app's engine that is not declared here, or when the manifest and this list disagree.
perms._doc_needs_1865: #1865 microphone: Play records audio tracks from the microphone (libs:canvas-play MicRecorder). Asked at runtime the first time REC arms an audio track; the instrument tracks still record played notes with no permission.

audio._doc: #1809 THE Play sound declaration. Two engines, picked on the Play page and remembered: soundfont (the default: FluidSynth playing a General MIDI SoundFont bank on an Oboe output) and classic (the #1787 engines kept as the fallback: the Salamander Grand Piano and MuldjordKit samples and the synthesized voices of audio/Synth.kt). classic also plays whenever the SoundFont engine cannot start (no native library for the ABI, the bank cannot be loaded). app/build.gradle fetches and packages the pinned engine (soundfont.android_zip, libs) and bakes default_engine; the runtime configuration is assets/soundfont/soundfont.json (soundfont.config_asset), which audio/SoundFont.kt decodes and tools/sf-render/plan.py reads for the CI offline render (canvas-soundfont-render.yml); SoundFontTest proves every instrument resolves to a preset of the bank.

soundfont._doc_engine: FluidSynth (LGPL-2.1-or-later), dynamically linked: its official Android build (fluidsynth-<version>-android24.zip, every .so 16 KB-aligned, Oboe 1.9.0 inside) is fetched at build time by app/build.gradle (fetchFluidSynth: pinned URL + sha256, only the libraries in libs are packaged). Chosen over TinySoundFont because GeneralUser GS needs SoundFont 2.01 modulators: its author's compatibility table rates TinySoundFont 'Poor: out of spec in crucial ways, no modulator support' and FluidSynth 'Excellent' (documentation/README.html of the bank).
soundfont._doc_libs: The NEEDED closure of libfluidsynth.so (readelf -d), nothing else of the zip. liboboe.so is the zip's Oboe 1.9.0 (16 KB-aligned; the Maven prefab build of 1.9.0 is 4 KB-aligned and would fail the page-size guard); the app's own libcanvasaudio.so links it, compiled against the headers of oboe_headers_aar (the same 1.9.0).

bank.name: GeneralUser GS
bank.author: S. Christian Collins
bank._doc: Bundled (32.3 MB, stored uncompressed and read in place from the APK through FluidSynth's sfloader callbacks over AAssetManager; about 31 MB of RAM once loaded). The licence allows use in software and asks for a local copy rather than a link to the author's download files.

soundfont._doc_config_asset: The runtime half (bank identity, output stream, channel layout, GM presets, drum keys, FluidSynth settings) lives in app/src/main/assets/soundfont/soundfont.json beside the bank it describes, so this block keeps only what the build needs: the engine's pinned binaries, the libraries to package and the bank's pin.

classic._doc: The #1787 engines, unchanged in sound: Salamander Grand Piano V3 and MuldjordKit samples (assets/samples) and the synthesized voices; decoded only when Classic plays (selected, or the SoundFont engine is unavailable).
